data.long_meaning: Derived from Petronius, a Roman family name meaning 'rock' or 'stone'. Petronilla may also be associated with St. Petronilla, a virgin martyr who was said to have been buried in Rome with St. Peter. The name Petronilla carries the meaning “Rock, stone” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Petronilla usually hope their child will grow to embody rock, stone and live with faith, good character and purpose.
